reason: Abandoned: this task pursued read-isolation of the review subprocess, which is not a launcher goal. Process isolation is delegated to the vendor sandbox (--sandbox read-only), and review integrity binds reviewed_commit to the candidate SHA, not to filesystem confinement, so read-isolation was never required. The exploratory env-hardening additionally regressed reviewer startup when the reviewer binary is installed in a repo-local venv (component-wise PATH filtering). No implementation merged; the original launcher is retained.
